_note: UI strings, English. Same keys as cs.json.
connect_body: The app reads Wikipedia, maps and guides straight from the drive. The books stay on the drive and you need no internet.
connect_step_plug: Plug the drive into the USB-C port.
connect_step_pick_android: On the next screen, tap “Use this folder” at the bottom, then “Allow”. The app only reads the drive.
connect_step_pick_ios: On the next screen, pick OFFLINKA and tap Open.
connect_remember: The app remembers the drive. Next time, just plug it in.
connect_searching: Looking for books on the drive…
connect_err_notfound_body: Push it all the way into the port and wait a few seconds. Unplugging and plugging it back in also helps.
connect_err_wrongfolder_body: Pick the OFFLINKA folder, or the Knihovna folder inside it.
connect_err_noaccess_body: Tap “Choose again”, then “Allow” on the next screen.
help_title: If the drive doesn't show up
help_1: Push the drive all the way in. USB-C fits either way up.
help_2: Unplug it, wait a few seconds and plug it back in.
help_3_android: Oppo, Realme and Vivo phones have an OTG switch in settings. Turn it on, or the phone won't see the drive.
help_4_ios: iPhone 14 and older have a Lightning port. The drive doesn't fit it.
help_5: A thick phone case can stop the plug going in. Try without it.
unplugged_body: Plug it back in to continue where you left off.
book_wikipedia_en_desc: The million most-read articles, text only
book_maps_desc: From the whole country down to streets
book_guides_desc: First aid, power cuts, how-tos (in Czech)
search_tip: Accents are optional: “cesky krumlov” finds Český Krumlov.
search_no_results_body: Search looks at article titles. Try one word, like “bleeding”.
reader_not_found_body: This page isn't on the drive.
reader_external_title: This link goes to the internet
reader_external_body: Offlinka works without internet, so it won't open this link.
library_group_phone_note: Used only when the full edition is missing.
library_replaced: The full edition is used instead
saved_empty_body: Tap the bookmark in an article to keep it here.
saved_unavailable: This book isn't on the connected drive
history_empty_body: Articles you open will show up here.
settings_text_size_preview: This is how article text will look.
settings_keep_copy_body: Copies the smaller edition (about 1 GB) to the phone, so you can read article intros without the drive.
settings_privacy_note: Everything stays on this phone. The app never uses the internet.
about_tagline: Wikipedia, maps and guides from the drive. No internet.
about_privacy_body: The app has no internet access, collects no data and has no accounts or ads.
about_lic_wikipedia: Wikipedia and sister project texts: Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0
about_lic_zim: ZIM books prepared by the Kiwix and openZIM projects
about_lic_fonts: Archivo typeface: The Archivo Project Authors, SIL OFL 1.1
about_notices_body: Libraries the app uses and their licences
about_trademark: Wikipedia is a trademark of the Wikimedia Foundation. We are not affiliated with it.
error_body: The book didn't open. Try again. If that doesn't help, unplug the drive and plug it back in.
error_unsupported: The app can't open this type of file.
cd_drive_illustration: A phone with the drive in its USB-C port
help_picker_menu: The window shows a different folder? Tap the three lines at the top left and pick OFFLINKA.
help_pick_folder: If the phone won't let you pick the whole drive, open it and pick the Knihovna folder.
help_exfat: Some phones with Android 8 to 10 can't read the drive. The emergency guides are built into the app, and a computer opens the rest.
connect_slow: A big drive, this can take a moment.
search_index_building: Search is getting ready ({n}%). For now, type with accents.
library_index_offer_body: Finds articles by any word in the title. Preparing takes about 10 minutes and 220 MB. The phone gets warm, so keep it on the charger and the app open. You can read in the meantime.
search_no_results_indexing: Search is still getting ready. For now, type Czech words with accents.
search_ready: Search is ready. Accents are now optional.
help_group_not_seen: The phone doesn't see the drive
index_queued_body: It starts when the other books are ready.
index_low_space_body: The phone is low on space. Free about 300 MB and try again.
reader_file_too_big: This file is too big to open on the phone.
